sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (individual or floater basis)

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 2% of SI per day subject to maximum of ₹5,000/day. Proportionate deduction applies to other expenses if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 5% of SI per day subject to maximum of ₹10,000/day.

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim amount.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever is lower. Modern/advanced treatments (robotic surgery, etc.): up to 50% of SI. Room rent and ICU also sub-limited.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, varicose veins, hysterectomy, etc. 36-month wait for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made. Maximum 50% of SI.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses cover in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc. covered up to 50% of SI.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables/non-medical items in Annexures. No consumables cover rider available.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; territorial limit is India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, domiciliary/OPD, treatment outside India, war, nuclear/bio/chemical, sterility/infertility, cosmetic surgery, adventure sports (professional)
